connector.name: Omnier
connector.registryDescription: Turn signals from email, CRM, and meetings into a prioritized daily sales to-do list.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.getomnier.com over streamable HTTP. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the jessesorsa account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token from Omnier OAuth (Authorization: Bearer <access_token>). Connect via Claude or Claude Code and complete sign-in at getomnier.com—see https://getomnier.com/docs/getting-started
